title: Spec's 'catalog_hash header re-bless is the only T1 shift' is literally impossible — the T1 hash binds catalog_hash, so every per-tick line must move; verified zero sim change anyway
evidence: spec line 29: "existing light demos' T1 stays byte-identical (catalog_hash header re-bless is the only T1 shift)". core/serialize.odin:85-90: "w_u64(&w, state.seed) / w_u64(&w, state.tick) / w_u64(&w, state.rng.state) / w_u64(&w, state.rng.inc) / w_u8(&w, state.era) / w_u64(&w, state.catalog_hash)" — and the binding is pre-existing (git show 8ece056:core/serialize.odin contains the same w_u64(&w, state.catalog_hash); the 29d08dc serialize diff touches only the Packet_Dropped tag-conditional payload). Diff reality: every light demo's .t1 shows all per-tick lines changed, e.g. goldens/boot.t1 "-1 692b13aed9005ede ... -100 fbc1f8e3516a0be7" / "+1 47151bb2562fbe59 ... +100 4f9b629799ddc3d0". Verification: `./bin/harness run boot bundle demolish draw flow lose place` at ffc9b7b → "PASS boot ticks=100 / PASS bundle ticks=70 / PASS demolish ticks=80 / PASS draw ticks=60 / PASS flow ticks=60 / PASS lose ticks=64 / PASS place ticks=80 / harness: 7 demo(s) green" — T1, replay gate and T2 pixels all reproduce the new manifests, i.e. the per-tick shifts are exactly the catalog binding, not sim drift.
detail: Spec wording can be misread as 'only the header line changes'. The code mandates all per-tick lines shift with the hash (state.catalog_hash rides the T1 serialization). Substance holds: harness PASS proves zero sim change; header hash afe505119369d195 recomputed exactly.
recommended_fix: Rephrase spec line 29 to 'the catalog_hash re-bless is the only T1 shift CAUSE (the per-tick lines re-derive from the binding)' so future reviewers don't misread per-tick shifts as drift.

title: 'Contention shifts in ecmp' cannot be true — ecmp's traffic can never engage E9/E22; its T1 shifts are purely the catalog binding (goldens still correct)
evidence: Commit 29d08dc message: "and contention shifts in qos/qos_emphasis/ecmp. Light demos unchanged". demos/ecmp.dem: "at 1000ms spawn 0 3 / at 1100ms spawn 0 3 / at 1200ms spawn 0 3 / at 1300ms spawn 0 3" (4 packets, ~6-tick transit each, max 2 in flight — per the file's own comment "pkt1 (t20): t20 fwd res->m2 ... t25 DELIVER"). data/balance.json: "\"lane_queue_packets\": 6," and "\"pool_max_packets\": 512,". Byte check: git show 8ece056:goldens/ecmp.log.bin vs goldens/ecmp.log.bin → "ecmp: old=109 new=109 differing_bytes=8 first_diff_byte=18" (only the header catalog_hash field). `./bin/harness run ecmp` → "PASS ecmp ticks=80".
detail: A lane queue (bound 6) or pool (512) cannot fill with ≤2 concurrent packets, so E9/E22 never fires in ecmp; its per-tick shifts are the same catalog binding as the light demos. Claim mischaracterizes the cause; no golden is wrong.
recommended_fix: Drop ecmp from the 'contention engages' list in the commit message and spec line 76 (keep qos/qos_emphasis), or keep ecmp listed only as header-binding shift.
